integrity.evidence_basis: Analytical commutator plus uniform degenerate perturbation with finite numerical support.

scientific_limitations: Fixed interval length a>0; separation tends to infinity.
Detuning parameter t remains in any fixed bounded interval.
Only the top two eigenvalues are analyzed; the critical detuning is not claimed to give exact degeneracy.
A classical one-interval prolate simplicity and gap fact is a referenced premise.
title: Resonant doublet splitting for Paley–Wiener concentration on distant intervals
